title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): find meetings by topic or keyword in meeting body, chat and transcript
summary: Hold: the briefing treats licensing and mailbox scope as unpublished even though Microsoft's Copilot Search and requirements pages document them. It also directs readers to meeting policies for transcript viewing permissions, whereas Microsoft distinguishes those permissions from the transcription policy. The roadmap facts and the four control paths and commands are supported.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no UI or API switch specifically for turning topic-and-keyword meeting search on or off independently.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords disable admin policy Graph; Copilot meeting search disable policy Graph. Opened configure-copilot-admin-center, copilotpolicysetting-update, resources/copilotpolicysetting, Copilot Search overview and FAQ; no independent meeting-search switch.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government and education plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.

claims.claim: The licensing model for this new search capability is add-on.
claims.quote: Page: model: "add-on". Microsoft: "No, there's no additional cost for Microsoft Copilot Search itself. It's included as part of the Microsoft Copilot license."
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Add 'Copilot Search is included as part of the Microsoft Copilot license' to licensing.notes and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-search-faq. Retain the existing explanation of how the underlying Copilot licence is purchased.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether Copilot Chat users without a Microsoft Copilot licence receive this search is not stated.
claims.quote: No, Microsoft Copilot Search is not included with Microsoft Copilot Chat. While both are part of the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, they are licensed and delivered differently.
claims.fix: Replace the licensing uncertainty with 'Microsoft Copilot Search requires an eligible Microsoft Copilot licence and is not included with Microsoft Copilot Chat; users without that licence retain Microsoft Search.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-search-faq and remove the corresponding Open questions bullet.

claims.claim: The feature's release-notes entry itself names no licence or separate charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords license meter billing; Copilot meeting search license topics. Read the complete 559110 release-notes entry, including Details and Try this; it names no licence or charge.

claims.claim: No meter specific to this meeting-search feature is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords Copilot Chat license meter billing transcript search. Opened release notes, copilot-license-options, Copilot Search overview and FAQ; no meeting-search meter is named; Search itself is included.

claims.claim: The feature-specific description on Learn is confined to its release note.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords; Copilot meeting topic keyword search ranking mailbox sources events calls documentation. Results describe 559110 in release notes; opened Copilot Search overview and FAQ for surrounding-product documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe how results for this particular meeting-search feature are ranked.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot meeting topic keyword search ranking mailbox sources events calls documentation. Read 559110 release note, Copilot Search overview and FAQ; general semantic and personalisation descriptions give no feature-specific ranking rules.

claims.claim: Which mailbox sources are read is not described.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot supports primary mailboxes hosted in Exchange Online. Copilot can also use content that a user is permitted to access in archive, shared, and delegate mailboxes.
claims.fix: Narrow 'which mailbox and chat sources are read' to 'how this feature selects meeting-body, chat and transcript sources for an individual result'. The product's mailbox scope is documented; the feature-specific source-selection mechanism is not.

claims.claim: Whether this particular search includes events and calls is not described.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot meeting topic keyword search ranking mailbox sources events calls documentation. Read 559110 entry and Copilot Search overview/FAQ; no explicit 559110 scope for calls, webinars or town halls.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot surfaces only organisational content the signed-in user already has at least view permission to access.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.claim: Transcripts are stored with meeting recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint storage.
claims.quote: Transcripts are stored together with meeting recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint storage.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Sharing and file permissions govern access to stored meeting recordings and transcripts.
claims.quote: All meeting invitees, except for external participants, automatically get a personally shared link. The meeting organizer must add external participants to the shared list.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/tmr-meeting-recording-change to sources for the stored-file permissions statement.

claims.claim: The feature description identifies no new identity or consent mechanism.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords disable admin policy Graph; Copilot meeting topic keyword search documentation. Read complete 559110 entry and privacy page; no identity or consent change is described for this search.

claims.claim: The release note describes finding and listing meetings rather than an autonomous action on the user's behalf.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords. Read complete 559110 release note: enter query, review results, select a meeting; it describes no autonomous action.

claims.claim: The levers deciding who can read transcripts are set in Teams meeting policies.
claims.quote: | Who has access to the recording and transcript **(Teams Premium/Copilot license)** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
claims.fix: Replace 'The levers that matter are the ones that decide whether transcripts exist and who can read them, set in Teams meeting policies' with 'Teams meeting policies govern whether users can transcribe meetings; sharing and file permissions govern access to stored transcripts.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/tmr-meeting-recording-change.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Transcription policy controls whether meetings can produce transcripts.
claims.quote: For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Transcription is both a per-organiser and a per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.claim: Transcription is on by default for new policies.
claims.quote: Toggle Transcription On or Off. This setting is On by default for new policies.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription reaches the transcription control.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $false sets meeting transcription off.
claims.quote: To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses reaches licence assignment.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. ... Select a product. ... On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. ... Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()
